title: Brilliant day hitting  some of the main attractions!
text:
Our Segway tour was absolutely the highlight of our trip!  We had a brilliant day exploring some of the city’s most iconic attractions, including Casa Batlló, Casa Milà, Sagrada Família, and Arc de Triomf, unlike other tours that mainly stick to the beach, this one took us right through the heart of the city, giving us a fantastic overview of the main sights.

We were a group of 5 and as complete novices, it was a slow start as we also didn't  have long to practice (10 mins) including do's and don't, before setting off - you really do learn as you go!  By the end, we felt like experts and were
author: charlyp132016

title: Perfect tour
text: I can’t recommend this tour enough! The guide (sorry, lost the card and only remember his name starts with „K”) was very knowledgeable and I’ve learned lots of interesting facts from him. He made the tour very interesting and since I’ve already had a good grasp of Segway we managed to go faster and see so much in those 2.5hrs! Despite Barcelona being crazy busy the tour guide kept it very professional and very safe. I would happily do this tour again.
author: Izabela_K
